title: Wooden Debowler Stand W/ Steel Spike (for Dynavap)
description:
Debowler Stand With Steel Spike
Built for use for Dynavap and other like devices. This wooden debowler stand has 3 magnets imbedded into the wood for holding your dynavaps and for removing dynavap caps. In the centre of the spent herb dish is a solid steel spike which helps dig out spent herb.
Included
1 x Wooden Debowler Stand
1 x Solid Steel Spike
